title: Obtain reference B3LYP/6-311+G* most-stable-isomer geometries
action: Using a DFT program, perform B3LYP/6-311+G* geometry optimizations for each cluster composition (Si₂, CuSi, Si₃, CuSi₂, Si₄, CuSi₃, Si₅, CuSi₄) starting from plausible initial structures. For each composition, test several candidate isomers to identify the lowest-energy structure (most stable isomer). Confirm each structure is a true minimum by checking for absence of imaginary vibrational frequencies. Save the final Cartesian coordinates of each most-stable isomer for use in the next step.
description: Generates the starting geometries needed for the functional benchmark; the agent may store optimized structures as XYZ or output logs in a dedicated folder.

title: Compute equilibrium geometries for six functionals and compile table
action: For each of the six exchange-correlation functionals (OLYP, OPW91, OB95, VSXC, PBE0, B3LYP), perform a full geometry optimization for every cluster using the 6-311+G* basis set, starting from the reference B3LYP geometry obtained in the previous step. After optimization, run a frequency calculation to confirm the structure is a minimum. From the optimized structure, extract the following geometric parameters using the exact parameter names given: - Si2: r(Si-Si) - CuSi: r(Si-Cu) - Si3: r(Si1-Si3), r(Si1-Si2), α(Si1-Si3-Si2) - CuSi2: r(Si1-Cu), r(Si1-Si2), α(Si1-Cu-Si2) - Si4: r(Si1-Si4), r(Si1-Si2), α(Si1-Si3-Si2) - CuSi3: r(Si1-Cu), r(Si1-Si3), α(Si1-Si3-Si2), α(Si1-Cu-Si2) - Si5: r(Si1-Si2), r(Si1-Si3), r(Si3-Si4) - CuSi4: r(Si1-Cu), r(Si4-Cu), r(Si1-Si2), r(Si1-Si3), r(Si1-Si4), α(Si3-Si1-Si2-Si4). Compile all extracted values into a single CSV file.
description: CSV file containing the computed bond lengths and bond angles for every cluster/functional combination, enabling a direct comparison with the hidden B3LYP reference.
output_schema: Columns: cluster (string: Si2, CuSi, Si3, CuSi2, Si4, CuSi3, Si5, CuSi4), functional (string: OLYP, OPW91, OB95, VSXC, PBE0, B3LYP), parameter (string: must match one of the exact parameter strings listed above per cluster), value (float), unit (string: Å or °). Every (cluster, functional, parameter) combination listed must appear exactly once.
